epics.description: Create, list, complete, delete and edit.

acceptance_criteria: Given an empty list When I submit the title 'Buy milk' Then a new open item is returned with status 201
Given an empty list When I submit an empty title Then the API answers 422 and creates no item
stories.i_want: to add a to-do item with a title
stories.so_that: I can keep track of what I need to do
stories.title: Create item

acceptance_criteria: Given three items When I list the items Then all three are returned in creation order
Given no items When I list the items Then an empty list is returned
stories.so_that: I know what is on my list
stories.title: List items

acceptance_criteria: Given an open item When I mark it done Then it is returned as completed
Given an unknown item id When I mark it done Then the API answers 404
stories.i_want: to mark an item as done
stories.so_that: I can see what is left
stories.title: Complete item

acceptance_criteria: Given an item When I delete it Then it no longer appears in the list
Given an unknown item id When I delete it Then the API answers 404
stories.title: Delete item

acceptance_criteria: Given an item When I change its title Then the new title is returned and listed
Given an item When I change its title to an empty text Then the API answers 422 and the title stays
Given an unknown item id When I change its title Then the API answers 404
stories.i_want: to change the title of an item
stories.title: Edit title

epics.title: Manage to-dos

acceptance_criteria: Given open and completed items When I filter by open Then only open items are listed
Given open and completed items When I filter by done Then only completed items are listed
Given any items When I filter by an unknown status Then the API answers 422
stories.i_want: to list only open or only completed items
stories.so_that: I can focus on the work that is left
stories.title: Filter by status

nfrs.measure: 95% of requests answered in under 200 ms with 1,000 items
nfrs.requirement: The API shall answer every request within a fixed time limit.

nfrs.measure: 100% of invalid requests answered with 422 and no item changed
nfrs.requirement: The API shall reject invalid input without changing any data.

nfrs.measure: At least 1 passing pytest test per acceptance criterion
nfrs.requirement: Every story shall be covered by automated tests before release.

output.summary: Created a backlog with 2 epics and 6 stories (16 points)
output.vision: A tiny to-do web API that lets people add, list, complete, edit, delete and filter their to-do items.
